title: gh-hush configuration
description: Version 3 policy used by gh-hush to decide which GitHub notifications to keep and hush, expressed as identity, defaults, and an ordered list of data-described rules.

version.description: Configuration schema version. Must be 3; run gh hush migrate-config to upgrade an older file.

identity.description: The acting user, their primary organization, and their teams. Predicates resolve me and my_teams against these.

user.description: GitHub login that must match the account authenticated by gh.

teams.description: Teams referenced by my_teams, in org/team-slug form. Each org must match identity.organization; matching and uniqueness are case-insensitive.

defaults.description: Terminal fallback action and the global safety posture for unavailable evidence.

action.description: Terminal action applied when no rule matches.

on_missing_evidence.description: Action taken when a rule needs GitHub evidence that could not be fetched.

rules.description: Ordered match/action rules. The first rule whose condition matches wins.

items.description: One rule. name is the report identity, action is keep or hush, and when is the condition. An omitted when matches every notification.

name.description: Human-readable rule identity used in preview and explain output.

action.description: Action applied when this rule matches first.

predicate.description: A composable condition. Sibling keys form an implicit all. any, all, and not compose child conditions; the remaining keys are leaf predicates.

any.description: Matches when any child condition matches.

all.description: Matches when every child condition matches.

not.description: Matches when the child condition does not match.

repository.description: Matches on repository owner and name.

subject_type.description: Matches the notification subject type, e.g. PullRequest, Issue, Discussion.

state.description: Matches subject state: open, closed, or locked.

state_not.description: Matches when the subject state differs from the given state.

reason.description: Matches GitHub's notification reason, e.g. mention, assign, author.

author.description: Matches the subject author; me resolves to identity.user.

assignee.description: Matches a current assignee; me resolves to identity.user.

review_requested.description: Matches a current individual review request; me resolves to identity.user.

review_requested_team.description: Matches a current team review request; my_teams resolves to identity.teams.

mentions_user.description: Matches an @-mention of a user; me resolves to identity.user.

mentions_team.description: Matches an @-mention of a team; my_teams resolves to identity.teams.

search.description: Scope for mentions predicates: body and/or comments.

age.description: Matches on the notification update age.

owner.description: Repository owner must equal this login.

owner_not.description: Repository owner must not equal this login.

any_of.description: Repository full name or glob, e.g. github/dependency-*.
